name: Message Function 46 Code
definition: Type of message supporting a service.

AUTQ.name: Authorisation Request
AUTQ.definition: The initiator requests an authorisation without financial impact to complete the transaction.

AUTP.name: Authorisation Response
AUTP.definition: Response for authorisation without financial capture.

CMPV.name: Completion Advice
CMPV.definition: Advice for completion without financial capture.

CMPK.name: Completion Advice Response
CMPK.definition: Advice response for completion without financial capture.

DCRR.name: Currency Conversion Advice Response
DCRR.definition: Advice response for the currency conversion from the service provider to the acceptor.

DCCP.name: Currency Conversion Response
DCCP.definition: Response from a dynamic currency conversion.

FAUQ.name: Financial Authorisation Request
FAUQ.definition: Request for authorisation with financial capture.

FAUP.name: Financial Authorisation Response
FAUP.definition: Response for authorisation with financial capture.

FCMV.name: Financial Completion Advice
FCMV.definition: Advice for completion with financial capture.

FCMK.name: Financial Completion Advice Response
FCMK.definition: Advice response for completion with financial capture.

FRVA.name: Financial Reversal Advice
FRVA.definition: Advice for reversal with financial capture.

FRVR.name: Financial Reversal Advice Response
FRVR.definition: Advice response for reversal with financial capture.

RVRA.name: Reversal Advice
RVRA.definition: Advice for reversal without financial capture.

RVRR.name: Reversal Advice Response
RVRR.definition: Advice response for reversal without financial capture.

CDDQ.name: Card Debit Advice
CDDQ.definition: Advice for a Card Direct Debit.

CDDK.name: Card Debit Advice Response
CDDK.definition: Response to a Card Direct Debit Advice.

CDDR.name: Card Debit Request
CDDR.definition: Request to initiate a Card Direct Debit.

CDDP.name: Card Debit Response
CDDP.definition: Response to a Card Direct Debit Request.

NFRQ.name: Non Financial Request
NFRQ.definition: Initiator of the message requests additional information to the receiver.

NFRP.name: Non Financial Response
NFRP.definition: Provision of additional information to the issuer of a NonFinancialRequest.

TRPQ.name: Transaction Report Request
TRPQ.definition: Request to receive of a report of transaction from the issuer to the receiver.

TRPP.name: Transaction Report Response
TRPP.definition: Response to provide a sanitized report of transactions.

DCRQ.name: Currency Conversion Rate Request
DCRQ.definition: Request to receive catalogue of Currency Conversion rates.

DCRP.name: Currency Conversion Rate Response
DCRP.definition: Response with catalogue of Currency Conversion rates.
